chunks: Eat from the fish that has scales, and do not eat from it that which has no scale.

key_terms.اَلسَّمَكِ: fish as a category of sea animals for consumption
key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.فَلْسٌ: a scale; its absence indicates prohibition here
key_terms.فُلُوسٌ: scales on a fish, indicating permissibility here

ai.seo_question: Which fish are halal to eat according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about which fish are halal to eat. It permits fish that have scales and forbids fish that do not have scales, establishing a principle in dietary law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4152 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Eat from the fish that has scales, and do not eat from it that which has no scales."
